tags.label: Strength
tags.description: Adds strength; useful for attribute scaling and health-related benefits.

tags.label: Agility
tags.description: Adds agility; useful for attribute scaling, armor and attack speed.

tags.label: Intelligence
tags.description: Adds intelligence; useful for attribute scaling and mana-related benefits.

tags.label: All Attributes
tags.description: Adds strength, agility and intelligence together.

tags.label: Max HP
tags.description: Adds maximum health, increasing the damage the hero can survive.

tags.label: HP Regeneration
tags.description: Restores health over time; may be passive, temporary or provided by an aura.

tags.label: Instant Heal
tags.description: Restores health immediately through an active or triggered effect.

tags.label: Attack Lifesteal
tags.description: Restores health from eligible attack damage.

tags.label: Spell Lifesteal
tags.description: Restores health from eligible spell damage.

tags.label: Healing Amplification
tags.description: Amplifies healing or health restoration; the supported healing types vary by item.

tags.label: Ally Healing
tags.description: Provides health recovery to allied units.

tags.label: Damage Barrier
tags.description: Absorbs incoming damage up to a limit; includes physical, magical and all-damage barriers.

tags.label: Death Protection
tags.description: Provides protection against death or a return to life under specified conditions.

tags.label: Max Mana
tags.description: Adds maximum mana for casting more abilities.

tags.label: Mana Regeneration
tags.description: Restores mana over time, through a listed bonus, aura or temporary effect.

tags.label: Instant Mana
tags.description: Restores or grants usable mana immediately; some effects are temporary.

tags.label: Ally Mana Restoration
tags.description: Restores mana to allied units.

tags.label: Mana Regen Amplification
tags.description: Amplifies mana regeneration from applicable sources.

tags.label: Mana from Spell Damage Taken
tags.description: Converts incoming enemy spell damage into mana.

tags.label: Armor
tags.description: Adds armor, helping reduce incoming physical damage.

tags.label: Evasion
tags.description: Gives attacks a chance to miss; accuracy and true strike can bypass it.

tags.label: Attack Damage Block
tags.description: Blocks a fixed amount of eligible incoming attack damage.

tags.label: Physical Barrier
tags.description: Absorbs physical damage up to a barrier limit.

tags.label: Ethereal Protection
tags.description: Grants ethereal form, protecting against physical damage while preventing attacks.

tags.label: Damage Reflection
tags.description: Returns eligible incoming damage to its source.

tags.label: Magic Resistance
tags.description: Reduces incoming magical damage.

tags.label: Magic Barrier
tags.description: Absorbs magical damage up to a barrier limit.

tags.label: Enemy Spell Damage Reduction
tags.description: Debuffs enemies to reduce the spell damage they deal.

tags.label: Debuff Immunity
tags.description: Temporarily prevents many enemy debuffs from affecting the hero; some abilities pierce it.

tags.label: Status Resistance
tags.description: Shortens most affected debuffs; some effects ignore status resistance.

tags.label: Self Dispel
tags.description: Removes eligible negative debuffs from the user.

tags.label: Strong Self Dispel
tags.description: Removes eligible negative debuffs, including effects requiring a strong dispel.

tags.label: Ally Dispel
tags.description: Removes eligible negative debuffs from an ally.

tags.label: Spell Block
tags.description: Blocks eligible targeted spells when the effect is available.

tags.label: Spell Reflection
tags.description: Recasts eligible targeted spells at their caster; reflection alone does not block the original spell.

tags.label: Attack Damage
tags.description: Increases damage dealt by normal attacks; may include conditional bonuses.

tags.label: Attack Speed
tags.description: Increases attack frequency through a bonus or temporary effect.

tags.label: Critical Strike
tags.description: Gives eligible attacks a chance to deal increased damage.

tags.label: Armor Reduction
tags.description: Reduces enemy armor, increasing physical damage taken.

tags.label: True Strike / Accuracy
tags.description: Helps attacks bypass evasion. Accuracy is a chance; true strike guarantees a hit only for the attacks covered by the effect.

tags.label: Attack Range
tags.description: Extends attack reach; melee, ranged or temporary restrictions may apply.

tags.label: Cleave
tags.description: Spreads eligible melee attack damage to enemies behind the target.

tags.label: Multi-Target Attack Damage
tags.description: Damages additional targets through extra attacks, cleave or attack-triggered effects.

tags.label: Building Damage
tags.description: Provides an effect explicitly supporting damage against buildings.

tags.label: Spell Amplification
tags.description: Increases spell damage through amplification.

tags.label: Instant Spell Damage
tags.description: Deals a burst of magical damage through an item effect.

tags.label: AoE Spell Damage
tags.description: Deals magical damage to multiple enemies in an area.

tags.label: Magic Resistance Reduction
tags.description: Lowers enemy magic resistance, increasing magical damage taken.

tags.label: Cast Range
tags.description: Extends the distance from which eligible spells or items can be cast.

tags.label: Cooldown Reduction
tags.description: Reduces eligible ability or item cooldowns.

tags.label: Cooldown Reset
tags.description: Resets eligible ability cooldowns when activated.

tags.label: Movement Speed
tags.description: Increases movement speed, permanently or under specified conditions.

tags.label: Blink
tags.description: Teleports the user a short distance, with item-specific restrictions.

tags.label: Self Forced Movement
tags.description: Pushes or pulls the user without normal movement.

tags.label: Ally Forced Movement
tags.description: Repositions an allied unit through forced movement.

tags.label: Enemy Forced Movement
tags.description: Pushes or pulls an enemy unit.

tags.label: Map Teleportation
tags.description: Teleports across the map to valid allied destinations.

tags.label: Invisibility
tags.description: Conceals the user or an ally; detection and break conditions vary.

tags.label: Slow Resistance
tags.description: Reduces the strength of movement-speed slows.

tags.label: Stun
tags.description: Temporarily prevents a target from moving or acting.

tags.label: Silence
tags.description: Prevents a target from casting most spells for a duration.

tags.label: Root
tags.description: Prevents normal movement and restricts certain movement abilities.

tags.label: Movement Slow
tags.description: Reduces an enemy’s movement speed.

tags.label: Attack Speed Slow
tags.description: Reduces an enemy’s attack speed.

tags.label: Hex
tags.description: Transforms an enemy, restricting attacks, spells and item use.

tags.label: Disarm
tags.description: Prevents a target from performing normal attacks.

tags.label: Break
tags.description: Temporarily disables most passive hero abilities.

tags.label: Mana Burn
tags.description: Removes enemy mana, often dealing damage as well.

tags.label: Healing Reduction
tags.description: Reduces enemy healing or health restoration.

tags.label: Enemy Buff Dispel
tags.description: Removes eligible positive buffs from enemies; this is not a defensive dispel.

tags.label: Vision
tags.description: Provides vision or reveals information about an area.

tags.label: Invisibility Detection
tags.description: Reveals invisible units or wards under the effect’s conditions.

tags.label: Ally Save
tags.description: Provides a defensive tool for protecting or rescuing an ally.

tags.label: Team Armor
tags.description: Grants armor to allies through an aura or targeted effect.

tags.label: Team Magic Protection
tags.description: Protects allies from magical damage through resistance or barriers.

tags.label: Team Healing
tags.description: Restores allied health through an area effect or aura.

tags.label: Team Attack Buffs
tags.description: Improves allied attacks through damage or attack-speed effects.

tags.label: Wave Clear
tags.description: Helps clear groups of creeps through area or multi-target damage.

tags.label: Farming Speed
tags.description: Accelerates creep farming through extra creep damage, area damage or conversion.

tags.label: Summons / Controlled Units
tags.description: Creates or controls additional units, including illusions.

tags.label: Bonus Gold
tags.description: Provides extra gold or converts a creep into a gold reward.

basic.label: Max HP
basic.description: Low maximum health; vulnerable to burst damage

basic.label: HP Regeneration
basic.description: Health recovery is too slow between fights

basic.label: Attack Lifesteal
basic.description: Need health recovery through normal attacks

basic.label: Spell Lifesteal
basic.description: Need health recovery through spell damage

basic.label: Max Mana
basic.description: Insufficient mana for a full spell combination

basic.label: Mana Regeneration
basic.description: Running out of mana during prolonged gameplay

basic.label: True Strike
basic.description: Attacks missing due to enemy evasion

basic.label: Dispel
basic.description: A removable debuff is restricting actions

basic.label: Stun
basic.description: Enemy needs to be temporarily disabled

basic.label: Silence
basic.description: Enemy spells need to be interrupted or prevented
